His family and local authorities searched tirelessly, but it was a goat herder who ultimately discovered him on November 14, leading to his rescue.

Recently, they transformed an unused room in a government school into a library with over 2,000 donated books. The Chief of Defence Staff provided insights into the changing nature of warfare and its economic implications. Additionally, he noted India's defense exports and advancements in indigenous weapons capability.

title: When will Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli play next after disappointing NZ series?
description: Throughout the ODI series against New Zealand, Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli encountered difficulties at the crease. Despite Kohli leading the run charts for India, Rohit’s consistency faltered. Looking ahead to the white-ball series against Sri Lanka in December, their impressive track record against this opponent raises hopes for improved performances. These forthcoming matches present a perfect opportunity for both players to rediscover their rhythm.

title: Why Sooryavanshi missed Bihar's second SMAT match after historic captaincy debut

His departure meant Suraj Kashyap took over and led the team to victory against Railways. Sooryavanshi made history as the youngest captain in T20 cricket during his brief tenure. title: Modi meeting, Putin-Xi talks: What’s on Trump’s Asia agenda amid poll setback, Nvidia row

This centre will specifically handle rejected asylum seekers who have exhausted all legal options to remain in Europe. The countries aim to make this facility operational by 2027 and will initially accommodate around 100 migrants. The proposed arrangement reflects a broader shift in the EU’s immigration policy and deportation strategies.

title: Azam Khan sent to 14-day judicial custody after ED questioning in Jauhar University case
description: Mohammad Azam Khan has been remanded to judicial custody following a CBI court ruling after Enforcement Directorate custody. His arrest relates to a money laundering case involving Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur. The investigation centers on alleged financial irregularities involving public funds and land grabbing. Additional allegations include diversion of funds connected to multiple FIRs registered against him.

He underscored the significance of tenacity in cricket, drawing inspiration from Mohinder Amarnath's enduring legacy. With over ten successful years in Test matches behind him, Kohli is shifting his focus to ODIs, ready to carve out new victories.

title: 'No one excluded': CM Yogi says Census 2027 will ensure welfare benefits for all

Emphasizing the importance of precise data for identifying individuals missing from welfare initiatives, he outlined how this census will collect vital demographic details to inform the development of crucial infrastructure such as health centers and schools.

title: Lukaku retires as Belgium's highest goalscorer with 94 goals in 135 appearances
description: Romelu Lukaku has retired from international football at 33, ending a 16-year Belgium career as the country's all-time leading goalscorer with 94 goals in 135 appearances. The Fenerbahçe striker represented Belgium at four World Cups and three European Championships, including their historic third-place finish in 2018. His departure marks the end of an era for Belgium's golden generation.

title: India joins US-led alliance to secure AI supply chains amid China tech rivalry
description: India has taken a significant step by joining a US-led initiative alongside nine other nations to secure their artificial intelligence supply chains. This coalition is designed to protect sensitive technologies while countering competition from China. By creating working groups focused on cooperation in AI policy and security, these countries aim to fortify their economic and national security, building on last year's Pax Silica program that addresses critical resource safeguarding.

title: Saheb, Bibi, Spy, Employee aur AI Part 1: The rise of Jensen Huang
description: The plot is both complex and simple, as if a Bhojpuri auteur had directed a John le Carré thriller: a three-part epochal tale, like the Karla Trilogy, called Saheb, Bibi, Spy, Employee aur AI.

title: Jay Shah reappointed as ICC Chair; BCCI hails leadership ahead of cricket's Oly return
description: In a unanimous decision, Jay Shah has been reappointed as ICC Chair for a second term at the helm of world cricket. His new tenure will coincide with cricket's return to the Olympics at Los Angeles 2028. The BCCI hailed his contributions to the game, including the landmark launch of the Women's Premier League. Shah's second term comes at a crucial time as cricket looks to expand its footprint in emerging markets and reach wider audiences across the world.

title: US govt’s one sentence USCIS rule change that can impact H-1B visa extension forms
description: DHS has proposed a rule change that could affect the approval of visa extensions for foreign workers. The removal of deference to prior approvals may complicate extension applications, particularly for H-1B workers. As a result, this change could lead to more requests for evidence and longer processing times. Employers, especially small businesses, might face additional challenges with H-1B petitions.

title: 'Dalit oppression, land grab': BJP hits back at Akhilesh over 'Damdar Dalit' remarks

They pointed out the SP's past failures regarding Dalit issues during its tenure, with Uttar Pradesh MSME minister Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary highlighting various incidents of Dalit oppression.

title: 'I was waiting for him to bowl there': Arshdeep reveals secret behind late sixes

Siraj also recognized the importance of these runs, stressing their influence on the match's outcome. Arshdeep's outstanding bowling performance, securing three wickets, contributed significantly to India's 22-run win over New Zealand in the series finale.

title: 'Who ordered SIR?' Cong seeks SC nod to pose 48 questions to EC over 'vote chori'

They emphasize that their pressing inquiries into purported electoral roll irregularities remain largely unaddressed. The party has compiled a list of 48 detailed questions for the Election Commission, focusing on aspects such as the Special Intensive Revision process.

title: 'Bulletproof cabins won't save them': Gangster Goldy targets Amitabh, Abhishek Bachchan

This threat comes after unsubstantiated remarks made by Amitabh regarding the 1984 riots. Dhillon claimed that the recent arrest of his associates would not deter their operations in Mumbai. He stated that anyone opposing the Sikh community would be considered an enemy of his group.

Funded by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school focused on integrating education with healthcare for low-income families. Although it served nearly 540 children, the academic performance fell short of expectations, leading to its closure. CZI has committed $50 million to support affected families during this transition.
